notes: This catalog is designed for fraud risk assessment, detection engineering, control design, and red/blue team testing.
Step flows are intentionally high-level to support defensive testing without providing actionable instructions for wrongdoing.

scenarios.scenario_name: Synthetic identity retail DDA opening with early-life cash-out
prerequisites: Digital onboarding allows remote funding and transfers
telemetry_indicators: Device fingerprint reuse across multiple applicants
New-account high velocity of external transfers within first 7 days
recommended_controls: Layered identity proofing (document authenticity + liveness + data-source corroboration)
Early-life limits and stepped enablement for outbound rails
Device/behavioral analytics and network-linking of applicants

red_team: Create synthetic applicant cohort with shared device/phone patterns; attempt early outbound transfers in sandbox
Test early-life rail enablement gates and exception paths
blue_team: Alert: 'new account + high velocity + new payee' with risk score threshold; validate case workflow and holds
Measure false positives by cohort (new movers, salary accounts) and tune rules

scenarios.scenario_name: Stolen identity retail account opening (full-ID) with remote funding link
prerequisites: Document verification gaps or manual overrides
telemetry_indicators: Document authenticity risk flags; mismatched metadata
Repeated liveness retries or low confidence scores
External funding link attempts from new device/ASN
recommended_controls: Stronger document forensics, selfie liveness, and anti-spoof checks
Manual review with evidence requirements; restrict overrides
Cooling-off after funding link; out-of-band confirmation

red_team: Inject mixed-validity document bundles (synthetic) to validate forensics scoring
Simulate manual override attempt with missing evidence
blue_team: Detect: high doc-risk + override + funding link; enforce step-up and hold
Audit overrides and ensure reviewer notes are captured and immutable

scenarios.scenario_name: Business entity account opening with false beneficial owner / nominee director
prerequisites: Recently formed entity or shell structures
telemetry_indicators: Early pattern of pass-through payments with minimal operating activity
recommended_controls: BO verification + adverse media screening; corroborate registries
Phased limits and delayed high-risk rails for new entities
Network analytics linking entities by shared attributes

red_team: Create synthetic LLC cohort sharing contact attributes; attempt early high-value wire/ACH
Test KYB escalation and evidence capture
blue_team: Graph alert: many entities share BO/contact; validate entity-linking in case management
Validate 'early pass-through' monitoring for first 30–60 days

scenarios.scenario_name: Profile manipulation: address/phone/email change followed by payee add and transfer
prerequisites: Weak step-up controls on profile changes
telemetry_indicators: Contact change + password reset close in time
Device/geo shift coincident with profile change
New payee added shortly after profile change
recommended_controls: Step-up authentication and out-of-band verification for profile changes
Cooling-off for new payees/limit raises after profile changes
Customer notifications on profile edits with easy dispute mechanism

red_team: Simulate sequence: profile change → password reset → new payee add in test environment
Attempt to bypass step-up paths and log outcomes
blue_team: Correlation rule: profile change + new payee + outbound transfer within 24–72h
Runbook: customer contact, temporary holds, credential reset guidance

scenarios.scenario_name: Mule recruitment onboarding: coordinated new accounts used for cash-out network
telemetry_indicators: Multiple new accounts share devices or network attributes
ATM withdrawals clustered by time and location
recommended_controls: Graph/network analytics for mule patterns
Early-life monitoring and caps on outbound transfers/withdrawals
Enhanced customer due diligence on clustered behavior

red_team: Create synthetic mule graph: multiple new accounts with shared device; simulate fan-in/out
Test ATM/P2P velocity limits
blue_team: Detect clusters via graph scoring; confirm case linking and bulk action capability
Measure time-to-containment and recovery steps

scenarios.scenario_name: Document forgery: altered paystubs/utility bills to pass KYC and credit checks
scenarios.entry_vector: Document upload for onboarding or credit underwriting
telemetry_indicators: Employer/utility data mismatch vs third-party sources
High reuse of similar document templates across applicants
recommended_controls: Automated document forensics + template similarity detection
Third-party verification (employment/utility/phone) where permitted
Manual review playbooks for high-risk documents

red_team: Use synthetic altered documents (no real PII) to test forensic scoring and review queues
Test template-similarity detection across a batch
blue_team: Alert on high similarity clusters; verify reviewer actions and denial codes
Audit decision consistency and false rejection rate monitoring

scenarios.scenario_name: Deepfake / liveness bypass attempts in remote identity proofing
telemetry_indicators: Mismatch between selfie and document portrait embeddings
recommended_controls: Multi-modal liveness (challenge-response, passive signals) + anti-emulator checks
No silent fallback to weaker verification for high-risk
Re-verification before enabling outbound rails

red_team: Replay synthetic spoof patterns (emulator flags, repeated attempts) and validate blocks
Test fallback paths for bypass
blue_team: Detect: repeated liveness failures + retry; ensure rate limits and cooldown
Case workflow to request in-person/branch verification for elevated risk

scenarios.scenario_name: Business email domain spoofing used to open account as 'lookalike' supplier
scenarios.entry_vector: Commercial onboarding with business email validation
prerequisites: Lookalike domains possible; weak domain verification
telemetry_indicators: Email domain newly registered or close to known supplier domains
Early inbound from single counterparty then rapid outbound
recommended_controls: Domain intelligence checks (age, reputation, similarity)
Verification of business presence and beneficial owners
Hold first high-value outbound until verification complete

red_team: Create synthetic lookalike domains and attempt onboarding; test domain intelligence gating
Simulate first-payment outbound attempt post-onboarding
blue_team: Detect: domain similarity to known vendors + urgent wire pattern from customer AP
Runbook: verify supplier onboarding and block suspicious new vendor payees

scenarios.segment_differences: Commercial banks: integrate vendor/payee verification workflows; consumer banks: may apply to small-business customers.

scenarios.scenario_name: Account upgrade abuse: elevate limits/tiers using falsified business/occupation details
prerequisites: Self-serve upgrades or weak verification for tier changes
telemetry_indicators: Unusual rapid tier upgrades across linked accounts
Limit increases followed by outbound burst
recommended_controls: Risk-based tiering with verification for high tiers
Cooling periods post-limit increase
Post-increase monitoring and anomaly triggers

red_team: Simulate tier upgrade requests with inconsistent attributes; attempt immediate outbound burst
Test manual approval evidence requirements
blue_team: Alert: limit increase + new payee + outbound burst; validate automated temporary caps
Measure controls impact on legitimate upgrade journeys

scenarios.scenario_name: Dormant account reactivation with identity rebind (email/phone) leading to fraud
prerequisites: Dormant accounts with stale contact info
recommended_controls: Enhanced verification for dormant reactivation
Temporary limits for first 72h post-reactivation
Customer notifications to prior contact channels when possible

red_team: Simulate dormant reactivation with contact rebind and immediate transfer attempts
Test alternate recovery methods and logging
blue_team: Detect dormant reactivation + payee add within window; enforce holds and outreach
Validate audit trails and customer dispute handling

scenarios.scenario_name: Credential stuffing to ATO with subsequent payee addition and transfer
telemetry_indicators: Burst of failed logins across many users; bot fingerprints
New device + payee add + transfer within short window
recommended_controls: Bot mitigation and adaptive rate limiting
Risk-based MFA and step-up for anomalous logins
Payee add cooling + transfer velocity caps

red_team: Replay synthetic credential-stuffing patterns and confirm throttling + MFA triggers
Simulate success login followed by payee add and outbound attempt
blue_team: Detection: failed-login burst + later success + new device; validate auto-lock and outreach
Validate SOC triage workflow and customer reset guidance

scenarios.scenario_name: SIM swap/port-out leading to account recovery takeover
prerequisites: Attacker gains control of phone number
telemetry_indicators: Phone number change events; telecom risk signals
Password reset + device enrollment close in time
Outbound transfer attempts soon after recovery
recommended_controls: Stronger recovery (knowledge + device + out-of-band) and cooldowns
Number-change holds and step-up for high-risk
Telecom-risk integration where available

red_team: Simulate number change + recovery flow and attempt outbound transfers
Test 'cooldown' enforcement and exception handling
blue_team: Rule: phone change + password reset + transfer within 24–72h → hold
Validate customer notification and re-verification playbook

scenarios.scenario_name: Session hijacking (token reuse) enabling silent ATO without fresh MFA
telemetry_indicators: Missing expected device telemetry (e.g., secure enclave)
Sensitive actions without usual navigation patterns
recommended_controls: Token binding and short-lived sessions; re-auth for payee add/limit change
Anomaly detection on session posture changes
Auto-logout and forced re-login on risk

red_team: Simulate session ID reuse from changed network posture in test logs
Attempt sensitive actions without MFA to validate step-up
blue_team: Detect posture shift within active session; validate forced re-auth
Validate incident response: revoke tokens globally for affected user

scenarios.scenario_name: Call-center social engineering to reset credentials and disable MFA
telemetry_indicators: High rate of resets by certain agents
Overrides used more than peer baseline
Short call followed by high-risk transactions
recommended_controls: Stronger caller verification; step-up to verified channels
Dual control for MFA disable; supervisor approval
QA and audit on resets; agent risk scoring

red_team: Run scripted training calls in lab using synthetic profiles; attempt MFA disable
Test supervisor approval workflow and logging
blue_team: Monitor agent overrides + post-call transaction holds
Validate audit reports and coaching actions for outliers

scenarios.scenario_name: Mobile banking trojan/overlay leading to credential capture and transfer manipulation
telemetry_indicators: Mismatch between user intent confirmation and submitted payee details
recommended_controls: Device risk scoring + step-up for compromised posture
Transaction signing/confirmation that binds payee+amount
Payee reputation scoring and holds for high-risk

red_team: Simulate device-risk telemetry flags and confirm step-up
Generate synthetic 'intent vs submitted' mismatch events
blue_team: Detect 'intent-confirm mismatch' and block/hold; validate customer outreach
Validate fraud ops workflow for compromised-device cases

scenarios.scenario_name: Password reset abuse via email compromise (mailbox takeover)
telemetry_indicators: Email change or forwarding rules noted (if signals available)
recommended_controls: Require step-up verification on resets; trusted device checks
Notify via multiple channels; cooldown for new payees after reset
Risk scoring using email reputation signals where feasible

red_team: Simulate reset from unusual ASN + new device; verify step-up
Test cooldown enforcement for payee addition
blue_team: Correlation: reset + new payee + transfer; validate hold and verification
Validate customer comms templates and recovery checklist

scenarios.scenario_name: MFA fatigue (push bombing) to approve attacker login
prerequisites: No prompt rate limits or number matching
telemetry_indicators: Approval after long series of denies/timeouts
recommended_controls: Prompt rate limiting and cooldowns
Number matching / phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2)
User education and in-app reporting

red_team: Simulate repeated MFA prompts and ensure lockout/cooldown triggers
Test number-matching enforcement
blue_team: Alert: repeated MFA prompts to same user; auto block and customer warning
Validate SOC visibility and customer support scripts

scenarios.scenario_name: API token compromise (open banking/fintech connector) used to initiate transfers
prerequisites: Limited anomaly monitoring on API channel
telemetry_indicators: API calls from new IP ranges; unusual endpoints
Spike in sensitive actions (payee add, transfer initiation)
Mismatch between app usage and API activity
recommended_controls: Least-privilege scopes; short-lived tokens; rotation
API anomaly detection; allowlists for known partners
Step-up confirmation for sensitive API-originated actions

red_team: Simulate API channel calls from atypical IPs and verify blocking
Test scope restrictions and token revocation
blue_team: Detect 'API-originated payee add + transfer' pattern and hold for verification
Validate partner incident notification workflow

scenarios.segment_differences: Commercial: stronger partner governance and signed requests; Consumer: higher emphasis on aggregator token hygiene and user consent.

scenarios.scenario_name: Device enrollment hijack: attacker registers new trusted device after partial access
prerequisites: Partial access to account or recovery channel
Enrollment does not require strong step-up
telemetry_indicators: New device enrollment followed by sensitive actions
Device fingerprint differs significantly from baseline
Enrollment off-hours or from new geo
recommended_controls: Require strong step-up for device enrollment (phishing-resistant)
Notify and allow rapid revocation by customer
Cooling-off before high-risk transactions on newly enrolled devices

red_team: Simulate device enroll + immediate high-risk transfer; verify holds
Test revocation UX and logging
blue_team: Alert: new device enroll + transfer attempt; validate automated controls
Validate customer support path to revoke devices quickly

scenarios.scenario_name: Privilege escalation within digital banking roles (commercial entitlements misuse)
telemetry_indicators: Role/entitlement change events followed by new approvals/releases
Sudden ability to add beneficiaries or approve wires
recommended_controls: Dual control for entitlements; SoD enforcement
Entitlement change monitoring and just-in-time access
Immediate review/hold for first transactions after entitlement changes

red_team: Simulate entitlement change + wire release attempt in lab
Test SoD controls and audit trails
blue_team: Detect entitlement changes and gate high-risk approvals pending verification
Validate periodic entitlement recertification processes

scenarios.scenario_name: Bank impersonation ("fraud department") persuades customer to send P2P/ACH transfer
scenarios.entry_vector: Phone/SMS/social messaging leading to customer-authorized payment
telemetry_indicators: First-time payee; unusual transfer amount vs baseline
Short time from payee add to send
recommended_controls: Contextual scam warnings and confirm questions
First-time payee friction/holds for high-risk
Post-transaction outreach triggers when scam signals present

red_team: Create synthetic customer journeys: payee add → transfer with high amount and 'urgent' markers in notes
Test warning copy and user decision logging
blue_team: Detection: new payee + high amount + unusual device/geo; validate hold and outreach
Measure intervention effectiveness and update playbook

scenarios.scenario_name: Tech-support refund scam leads victim to send money back to attacker-controlled account
prerequisites: Victim trusts remote support; outbound transfer available
telemetry_indicators: Inflow labeled as refund/chargeback followed by rapid outbound to new payee
Multiple small outbound transfers to multiple recipients
recommended_controls: Education prompts; monitoring for 'refund then outbound' patterns
Holds on outbound after unusual inflows
Enhanced review when remote-access narratives appear in support notes

red_team: Simulate refund-like inflow followed by outbound transfers in synthetic transactions
Test hold policy thresholds
blue_team: Alert: unusual inflow then outbound within short window; validate case routing
Runbook: customer coaching and recovery steps

scenarios.scenario_name: Romance scam: gradual escalation of transfers over weeks/months
prerequisites: Longer time horizon; outbound rails available
telemetry_indicators: Behavioral drift: increased transfer frequency and amounts
Repeated customer reluctance markers in contact-center notes
recommended_controls: Behavioral baselines + drift detection
Escalation alerts and targeted scam warnings
Special handling for vulnerable populations

red_team: Generate synthetic time-series of escalating transfers and new recipients
Test drift model sensitivity to seasonality
blue_team: Validate slow-burn detection; ensure appropriate and privacy-safe interventions
Measure precision/recall and adjust thresholds

scenarios.scenario_name: Investment/crypto scam: repeated transfers to exchange then to new payees
scenarios.entry_vector: Persuasion to send funds to exchange or 'broker'
telemetry_indicators: New exchange payees; repeated transfers; increased amounts
Rapid churn (in/out) between bank and exchange
recommended_controls: Counterparty risk scoring and warnings for high-risk exchanges/entities
Limits and holds for first-time high-value transfers
Monitoring rapid churn patterns

red_team: Simulate repeated bank-to-exchange transfers and rapid churn in synthetic data
Test warnings and limit policies
blue_team: Alert: new exchange + high amount + repeat in days; validate hold/outreach
Validate dispute/intake playbook for scam reports

scenarios.scenario_name: Invoice redirection: vendor bank detail change leads to wrong beneficiary payment
scenarios.entry_vector: Email compromise or spoofing; AP workflow manipulation
prerequisites: Vendor change process lacks out-of-band verification
telemetry_indicators: Vendor bank detail change event close to payment
Urgent language and altered invoice metadata
recommended_controls: Out-of-band verification for vendor changes
Dual approval for payment instruction changes
Delayed first payment to new beneficiary pending verification

red_team: Simulate vendor bank change + immediate large payment request in AP sandbox
Test control checkpoints and evidence capture
blue_team: Detect: vendor detail change + payment within X days; enforce hold and verify
Validate case workflow linking vendor change to payment events

scenarios.scenario_name: CEO/CFO spoofing: urgent same-day wire request bypasses normal approvals
prerequisites: Approval process can be bypassed in emergencies
telemetry_indicators: High amount and new destination country/bank
recommended_controls: No 'emergency bypass' without dual control
Call-back verification using known numbers
Policy: first-time beneficiary wire requires additional verification

red_team: Simulate urgent payment request in workflow; attempt bypass and ensure it's blocked
Test approval chain enforcement and logging
blue_team: Alert: attempted bypass or approval chain deviation; validate containment
Audit for repeated urgent requests targeting same staff

scenarios.scenario_name: Job/offer scam: victim receives 'salary advance' then sends fees back (refund-like pattern)
scenarios.entry_vector: External scam leading to customer-authorized transfers
prerequisites: Victim makes outbound transfers; bank offers ACH/wire/P2P
telemetry_indicators: Small inflow followed by multiple outflows to new payees
Behavioral drift in customer transaction patterns
recommended_controls: Warnings for fee/advance patterns; monitoring inflow-outflow sequences
Caps/holds on first-time payees after unusual inflow
Education and self-reporting channel

red_team: Create synthetic inflow then multi-outflow pattern; test detection
Simulate customer support notes with scam keywords in test set
blue_team: Alert: inflow-outflow chain + new payees; validate outreach scripts
Measure intervention outcomes and adjust messaging

scenarios.scenario_name: Marketplace scam: buyer/seller dispute causes victim to send payment to 'escrow' mule account
telemetry_indicators: First-time recipient; unusual amount; 'goods/services' MCC absent
Rapid repeated attempts; different recipients suggested
Device/geo anomalies if combined with ATO
recommended_controls: Recipient verification prompts; hold for first-time high amounts
Customer confirmations and scam warnings
Velocity limits for repeated failed attempts

red_team: Synthetic P2P sends to first-time recipients with repeated attempts; test warnings/holds
Generate scenario where recipient changes mid-flow
blue_team: Detect repeated recipient changes and escalating amounts; validate blocks
Validate dispute intake workflow

scenarios.scenario_name: Charity/disaster scam: increased donations to new recipients with unusual geo/currency
scenarios.entry_vector: External solicitation leading to outbound payments
prerequisites: Customer willingness to donate; outbound rails enabled
telemetry_indicators: Spike in transfers to new recipients following news events (contextual)
Customer device/behavior pattern differs from baseline donation history
recommended_controls: Contextual warnings for new foreign beneficiaries
Recipient risk scoring and limits
Monitoring donation spikes and anomaly detection

red_team: Generate synthetic donation spikes to new beneficiaries with geo changes
Test alert thresholds during legitimate high-volume periods
blue_team: Validate anomaly alerts without over-blocking legitimate charity campaigns
Triage guidance for fraud ops

scenarios.segment_differences: Commercial: applies to corporate giving programs and employee-driven payments; require AP controls similar to vendor verification.

scenarios.scenario_name: Debt relief/loan consolidation scam: victim authorized ACH debits and later sends additional fees
scenarios.entry_vector: Inbound calls/web leads to customer agreement
prerequisites: Customer provides account details; ACH debits permitted
telemetry_indicators: New originator debits; repeated small debits; subsequent customer-authorized outbound transfers
recommended_controls: Originator risk scoring and debit blocks
Customer confirmation for new debits above thresholds
Education and dispute-friendly UX for unauthorized debits

red_team: Synthetic new-originator debit series + outbound fee payments; test detection
Simulate returns/complaints linkage
blue_team: Alert on new debitor + high return codes; validate blocking and outreach
Validate dispute intake and return handling

scenarios.scenario_name: CNP card testing (small auths) followed by digital goods purchases
prerequisites: Weak velocity and bot controls at merchant or issuer level
telemetry_indicators: Burst of low-value auths across many merchants
Purchases of digital/resellable goods; shipping/billing mismatches
recommended_controls: Issuer velocity rules + network intelligence
3DS/adaptive authentication
Merchant collaboration and blocklists for testing patterns

red_team: Generate synthetic auth-test bursts then successful purchases; verify detection thresholds
Simulate multiple merchants/MCCs to test cross-merchant correlation
blue_team: Alert on testing patterns and auto step-up/block; validate customer notification
Evaluate rule precision and reduce false positives for legitimate retries

scenarios.scenario_name: Lost/stolen card with rapid ATM withdrawals and POS burst
prerequisites: Physical access to card; optional PIN compromise
telemetry_indicators: Geo-velocity anomalies; consecutive ATM declines; unusual time-of-day
recommended_controls: Real-time SMS/app alerts; geo-velocity controls
ATM withdrawal caps; PIN retry limits
Instant freeze/unfreeze self-service

red_team: Simulate sudden geo shift + ATM burst + POS burst in synthetic timeline
Test auto-freeze triggers
blue_team: Validate alerting latency; verify freeze workflow and case creation
Post-event analytics: compare against baseline travel behavior

scenarios.scenario_name: Common point of purchase (CPP) cluster indicating skimming/shimming exposure
scenarios.entry_vector: Merchant/terminal ecosystem compromise (observed via issuer data)
telemetry_indicators: Card-present transactions at same merchant/terminal preceding later fraud
Cluster of impacted cards with shared merchant ID
Rise in counterfeit/CNP fraud after CPP exposure
recommended_controls: CPP analytics and rapid response
Merchant outreach and terminal inspections
Proactive reissue for clustered exposure

red_team: Create synthetic CPP cluster (same merchant ID) and downstream fraud; test cluster detection
Simulate partial clusters to test sensitivity
blue_team: Validate CPP alert workflow and evidence thresholding
Measure time-to-reissue and customer impact metrics

scenarios.scenario_name: Friendly fraud / chargeback abuse (legitimate purchase disputed repeatedly)
prerequisites: Digital goods or services hard to prove
recommended_controls: Dispute scoring and segmentation
Stronger evidence capture (delivery, device, usage)
Policies for repeat abusers with careful fairness checks

red_team: Generate synthetic customers with repeated disputes but normal spend patterns
Test scoring and policy actions
blue_team: Validate abuse detection vs genuine disputes; ensure appeal paths
Monitor outcomes and customer satisfaction metrics

scenarios.scenario_name: Prepaid card load-and-drain pattern with rapid spend after load
prerequisites: Easy load channels; weak KYC for higher tiers
telemetry_indicators: Immediate high spend after load; high-risk merchants
Multiple prepaid accounts linked by device/identity attributes
recommended_controls: Load velocity caps; KYC step-up for high-value tiers
Device/link analysis
Merchant risk scoring for rapid-drain merchants

red_team: Simulate load-split across multiple prepaid accounts with immediate spend
Test caps and step-up KYC triggers
blue_team: Validate clustering alerts and automated temporary caps
Measure loss reduction without excessive legitimate friction

scenarios.scenario_name: Card-present counterfeit fallback (magstripe) attempts after chip declines
prerequisites: Card data capture; merchants allow fallback
telemetry_indicators: Chip decline followed by magstripe fallback
recommended_controls: Tighten fallback rules; require additional verification
Merchant education; monitor high-fallback merchants
Real-time risk scoring for fallback attempts

red_team: Synthetic transaction stream: chip decline → fallback attempt bursts
Test decline reasons and control responses
blue_team: Alert on fallback attempt clusters; validate merchant risk outreach
Confirm policy enforcement and exception handling

scenarios.scenario_name: Card-not-present account takeover: saved card used after online account compromise
scenarios.entry_vector: Merchant account compromise (not bank), impacts issuer via spending patterns
telemetry_indicators: Sudden e-commerce spend on new merchant categories
Address/shipping changes at merchant (if shared via network)
recommended_controls: Issuer risk scoring for abrupt merchant-category shift
3DS step-up when available
Customer alerts and easy card lock

red_team: Generate synthetic spending shift with repeated declines then success
Test adaptive auth triggers
blue_team: Validate anomaly model and customer contact strategy
Measure false positives for seasonal spend changes

scenarios.scenario_name: Merchant collusion: fraudulent refunds to accomplice cards
telemetry_indicators: High refund ratio; repeated same card numbers
recommended_controls: Refund anomaly detection; merchant monitoring programs
Terminal/clerk-level controls
Chargeback/settlement holds for suspect merchants

red_team: Synthetic merchant data with refunds exceeding sales; test detection
Simulate clerk clustering
blue_team: Validate merchant monitoring dashboards and escalation
Confirm hold/review workflow for settlements

scenarios.scenario_name: ATM cash-out with compromised card + mule coordination (cash-out route clustering)
telemetry_indicators: Multiple cards withdrawing at same ATMs in short windows
Time clustering and route-like movement patterns
recommended_controls: ATM velocity and clustering detection
Cross-card correlation rules
Temporary ATM withdrawal caps for clustered risk

red_team: Synthetic multi-card ATM withdrawals across same ATM IDs and times
Test correlation alerts and caps
blue_team: Validate clustering alerts and rapid response
Post-event analysis for route patterns and model tuning

scenarios.scenario_name: Card tokenization abuse: multiple device tokens provisioned rapidly then used for high-risk spends
telemetry_indicators: Multiple tokens provisioned in short time
Device mismatch; new wallet provisioning attempts
High-risk MCC spending soon after token creation
recommended_controls: Strong token provisioning verification; step-up auth
Provisioning velocity limits and cooldowns
Monitoring first 24–48h wallet token activity

red_team: Simulate rapid token provisioning attempts and immediate spends
Test step-up and velocity limits
blue_team: Alert: multi-token provisioning + risky spend; validate blocks and customer outreach
Validate token deactivation and recovery workflow

scenarios.scenario_name: Unauthorized ACH debit by new originator (consumer accounts)
prerequisites: Bank lacks strong originator risk scoring or customer controls
telemetry_indicators: New originator seen; multiple small debits
Rising return codes for same originator
Spike in customer complaints linked to originator ID
recommended_controls: Originator risk scoring and monitoring
Customer debit blocks/filters; confirmation for new debits above thresholds
Automated containment when return/complaint rate spikes

red_team: Synthetic new-originator debits across many accounts; include varying amounts
Simulate return codes and complaint events
blue_team: Alert on originator with high returns/complaints; validate auto-block policies
Validate customer dispute workflows and timely returns handling

scenarios.scenario_name: ACH credit push after ATO: add external account and push credits
telemetry_indicators: New linked external account; payee added
Out-of-pattern ACH credits and repeated attempts
recommended_controls: Step-up on external account linking and first transfer
Cooling period for new external accounts
Velocity caps + anomaly-based holds

red_team: Simulate ATO risk event + external account link + ACH push attempts
Test cooling period and velocity caps
blue_team: Correlation: ATO risk + new external link + ACH push; validate holds and outreach
Validate SOC response and credential reset guidance

scenarios.scenario_name: Payroll diversion: direct deposit changed to attacker-controlled account
scenarios.entry_vector: Employer payroll change (outside bank) impacts deposit destination
prerequisites: Payroll portal compromise or HR manipulation
telemetry_indicators: Direct deposit changes for multiple employees to same receiving account
First payroll to new account followed by rapid withdrawals/transfers
Receiving account shows high fan-in on payday
recommended_controls: Encourage employers to use out-of-band confirmation; monitor receiving account fan-in
Hold/monitor first payroll deposits to new receiving accounts (risk-based)
Graph analytics for shared receiving accounts

red_team: Synthetic payday deposits fan-in to a single receiving account; simulate cash-out
Test receiving-side detection and holds
blue_team: Detect payday fan-in patterns; validate case linking and notification
Validate bank-employer coordination playbooks where applicable

scenarios.segment_differences: Consumer: employees impacted; Commercial: payroll clients and receiving accounts monitored for fan-in anomalies.

scenarios.scenario_name: Micro-deposit account validation enumeration (linking abuse)
telemetry_indicators: High volume link attempts; repeated failures
Same device/IP attempts across many accounts
recommended_controls: Rate limits and cooldowns; step-up verification
Alternative verification (instant account verification) where permitted
Monitoring and blocking enumeration patterns

red_team: Simulate high-frequency link attempts with repeated failures; test throttling
Generate sequential account patterns and observe detection
blue_team: Alert on enumeration signals; validate auto-block and case creation
Tune thresholds to avoid blocking legitimate multi-account users

scenarios.scenario_name: Corporate ACH batch compromise: new template and unusual beneficiaries
prerequisites: Weak dual control or approval anomalies
telemetry_indicators: New payment template; many new beneficiaries
Beneficiary accounts not previously used; rapid settlement
recommended_controls: Dual control + out-of-band approval for new templates
Beneficiary allowlists and staged ramp-up
Anomaly detection on batch creation and approvals

red_team: Synthetic batch creation off-hours with new beneficiaries; test holds and approvals
Test allowlist enforcement
blue_team: Alert: new template + many new beneficiaries; validate emergency freeze and recall runbook
Validate audit trail and approval evidence

scenarios.scenario_name: Account takeover via direct deposit switch fraud (consumer) plus outbound transfers
scenarios.entry_vector: Online profile + deposit routing change (where bank allows)
prerequisites: Bank allows direct deposit switch feature
telemetry_indicators: Subsequent inbound deposit then rapid outbound
recommended_controls: Step-up auth for deposit routing changes; cooldown
Monitor first deposit after change; risk-based holds
Customer alerts and easy rollback

red_team: Simulate deposit routing change + inbound deposit + rapid outbound
Test rollback workflow and notifications
blue_team: Detect deposit-change + immediate outbound; validate holds and outreach
Measure legitimate switch false positives and tune

scenarios.scenario_name: ACH return abuse: repeated 'unauthorized' returns used as a fraud cover for friendly fraud
telemetry_indicators: High rate of unauthorized return codes for same customer
recommended_controls: Return/dispute scoring; enhanced evidence requirements for repeat cases
Customer education; merchant verification for recurring debits
Careful fairness and regulatory compliance checks

red_team: Synthetic repeated 'unauthorized' returns for same customer across same originators
